strategies.name: trend_reversal_to_higher_timeframe_trend_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: Use the higher timeframe (4H/1H) trend bias first, then on the 15-minute or 5-minute chart wait for a bearish correction to stop making lower lows and then break above the most recent lower high. Enter on that bullish break as the lower timeframe turns back bullish in line with the higher timeframe.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss under the invalidation low/level that should not break if the bullish shift is real. Target the next higher-timeframe high (such as the 1H high), with the option to continue holding if the broader trend keeps expanding.
